confirmatory.claim: Useful high-load mean-response gain against both tested stock configurations, conditional on all prespecified safeguards

bootstrap.unit: whole content bundle with two arrival types, two loads, three arms
bootstrap.draw_indices_encoding: Concatenate complete [samples,6] tables in DATASETS order; little-endian signed int64 C-order bytes, no header.
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on selected external trace material, content construction and one hardware allocation; not uncertainty across new days or deployments

confirmatory.hierarchy: Stockoff primary, all14 guards and both-control date-deletion checks gate the stockon32 secondary; gain against a weaker comparator cannot rescue failure.

scope: Layer jobs; uncertainty conditional on fixed selected arrivals/content construction and one hardware allocation.
limitations: Controller tail is post-output extent, not exclusive controller cost; response ends at normal job ACK.
Coordinator busy fraction is host service occupancy, not GPU utilization.
Zero-denominator descriptive queue/drain ratios are null; absolute differences remain.
External source-row, bank/input and actual native-route auditors remain required.
